verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street's own products page offers employer-side multi-case management. It says you can run multiple cases in parallel with workflows, SLAs and status dashboards, it plugs into People Ops, and it supports forecasting spend across teams. Startup client logos (Replit, Midjourney) and a Y Combinator collaboration badge add context. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the dashboard and workflow features, a named startup or scale-up program with stated terms, and independent or hands-on confirmation of multi-case operation.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, I can run visas for a growing team through one provider — multi-case management or a stated startup/scale-up program beyond single founder cases

citations.quote: Run multiple cases in parallel with clean workflows, SLAs, and status dashboards.
We plug into your People Ops so nothing slips between candidate, manager, and attorney.
Forecast spend across teams, and avoid end-of-quarter cost surprises.
